label: GNSS L1 jammer — relocating static threat (6 km E → 8 km NW)
description: Same 25-pod mesh + C&C. Stationary GNSS L1 jammer at 6 km due east for the first 60 s sim, then relocates instantly to 8 km NW and stays there. Tests: (a) accurate localisation of a static emitter, (b) re-triangulation on relocation — bearing jumps from ~090° to ~315°, range jumps from 6 km to 8 km. Two distinct km buckets, two distinct bearing buckets, no smooth interpolation in between.
